answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that scales with headcount, not cleverness. Require each identity to burn scarce compute for admission, then keep an attestation wander across epochs so clones that go dark earn nothing. Peer panels grade original mechanism answers; copied text is rejected on-ledger, and honeypot graders lose seats. Tie emission to that continuous ember of verified work rather than signup count. Standing is a lantern: it only stays lit while recent answers pass, so farms pay forever just to look alive.
